fields.Name: T183 - Campaign Email Sends Drilldown
fields.Description: Verifies a Campaign's full record form exposes a related Email Sends (or Campaign Members) section that renders related rows or a valid empty-state.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Campaigns' entity via the left sidebar 'Search entities...' box: click the search box, type 'Campaigns', then click the exact 'Campaigns' node in the results (do NOT expand the entity group/chevron). Open a campaign record's full form (click a row, then click 'Open Full Record'). Scroll down to the form's related-records sections and open the 'Email Sends' (or 'Campaign Members') related section. Verify it shows related rows OR a valid empty-state (the related section being present and rendering is success). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait patiently, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A Campaign full record form is open showing campaign detail fields
A related 'Email Sends' or 'Campaign Members' section is present and rendering - showing related rows OR a valid empty-state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
